claims.assertion: Yazhi says the Federation is neither infiltrated nor inherently hostile but will not rescue Earth; its actions may seem negative from human needs.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She describes the institution as complex and historically unchanged.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says high-frequency thinking alone cannot solve Earth’s problems; people must act, and collective thoughts and actions shape perceived reality.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She distinguishes Earth from higher planes where thought alone may suffice.
